handedness.visual_basis: From DTL frames the golfer's left shoulder is closer to the target line and the left hip is the lead side at address, consistent with a right-handed stance.

temporal_orientation.visual_basis: Golfer at address over the ball with no visible motion away yet.
Hands and club have started away from the ball; shaft rising and club moving backward.
Continuation of club moving away; hands higher and behind initial address.
Hands and club near or at the top of the backswing; still moving away from the ball.
Hands remain high in backswing; still away from the ball.
Hands visible descending from the top toward the ball, indicating change of direction.
Club and hands clearly moving toward the ball in downswing and through impact region.
Follow-through frames show motion after the ball with club past impact area.
